T: New rules. Same rules. Not after midnight.
D: The gremlins break loose inside a high-tech Manhattan skyscraper.
P: Serve the snacks before midnight, still.
S: the tower full of shops and restaurants
Pork and cabbage potstickers folded, fried until the bottoms brown, steamed under a lid, with a soy and black vinegar dip.
the cooking show broadcast from inside the building
Corn chips layered with black beans, cheddar and jalapeño, baked at 200C for 8 minutes (the oven, not the microwave), salsa and sour cream.
the lobby deli in the smart building
Pastrami, Swiss and coleslaw on rye, cut into quarters and piled high on a deli platter.
M: Pastrami steamed 10 minutes until soft and piled high on rye spread with spicy mustard, a whole dill pickle and a creamy potato salad with celery and dill on the side.
the boss's very fancy top floor
Sirloin dry-brined overnight, seared hard in cast iron, pulled at 54C and rested, the pan deglazed with brandy, crushed peppercorns and stock, cream reduced in, with shoestring fries.
W: New York Italian bakery layers of almond sponge in three colours with jam and a chocolate top.
K: no water near the mogwai, again
Sparkling water with lemon and lime over ice, served well away from anything furry.

s.note: the tower full of shops and restaurants
s.how: Mix 400g pork mince with 2 cups shredded wombok, salted and squeezed, and 1 tbsp grated ginger. Fill 30 gyoza wrappers and pleat. Fry until browned, add water and steam under a lid for 4 minutes. Dip in soy and Chinkiang vinegar.

s.note: the cooking show broadcast from inside the building
s.how: Layer a 300g bag of corn chips with a drained tin of black beans, 200g grated cheddar and sliced jalapeños. Bake in the oven at 200C for 8 minutes, not the microwave. Top with diced tomato and 150g sour cream.

m.how: Steam 500g pastrami for 10 minutes until soft. Pile high on 8 slices rye spread with spicy mustard. Boil 600g potatoes, cool and toss with mayo, celery and dill. Serve each sandwich with a whole dill pickle.

w.how: Beat 200g almond meal paste, 200g butter, 200g sugar and 4 eggs, then fold in 150g flour. Divide in three, colour red and green, bake each thin at 180C for 12 minutes. Stack with apricot jam, top with 150g melted chocolate, chill and cut into small bars.

d.note: no water near the mogwai, again
d.how: Fill four glasses with ice and slices of lemon and lime. Pour over chilled sparkling water. Keep every glass well away from anything furry, and never after midnight.
